backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as the backend entry point for the Internet Computer canister.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three BlueFire logo placement features (header, hero, footer) with associated files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend React components and configuration files for the BlueFire cybersecurity website.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark modes with cybersecurity-themed color palette.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Spanish language, SEO meta tags for BlueFire cybersecurity targeting Mexican PYMEs and maquiladoras.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component rendering the complete single-page BlueFire website with Header and all section components in sequence.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section with Angel Medina's contact cards (email, phone, location) and a frontend-only validated contact form with Spanish labels.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying BlueFire logo (32px), services list, contact info, copyright with dynamic year, and caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed navigation header with BlueFire logo (40px) and brand name, plus smooth-scroll navigation links to Servicios, Programa Piloto, and Contacto sections.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section featuring BlueFire logo (48px) in badge with company name, Spanish tagline, dual CTAs, and three key cybersecurity statistics for Mexico.
frontend/src/components/MarketContextSec: Displays cybersecurity threat statistics for Mexico with four stat cards, a horizontal bar chart of most affected sectors (Finance, Health, Manufacturing), and an alert box highlighting PYME security gaps.
frontend/src/components/PilotProgramSect: Presents a pilot program offering a 48-hour vulnerability scan with a four-step process, deliverables list, optional remediation/retainer services, and a call-to-action button that scrolls to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/ReferralProgramS: Describes a referral program with four detail cards showing commission rates (15-30%), payment terms, and a three-step process explanation for referring clients and earning commissions.
frontend/src/components/SectorChart.tsx: Renders an SVG pie chart from sector data with percentage-based segments, calculates an "Otros" category to reach 100%, and displays a color-coded legend below the chart.
Showcases four cybersecurity services (Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Remediation, Network Segmentation) in a grid layout with icons, descriptions, necessity explanations, and benefit lists for each service.
frontend/src/components/TargetClientsSec: Presents two client segments (PYMEs and Maquiladoras) with their characteristics in comparison cards, plus four target client types (local SMEs, manufacturing plants, supply chain providers, MSPs) in a grid.
React component displaying a four-step cybersecurity workflow (Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Patching, Segmentation) with icons, stages, and an integrated workflow diagram image.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages an ICP backend actor using React Query, automatically recreating the actor when Internet Identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom cybersecurity-themed color palette (deep blue, cyan, slate gray) for both light and dark modes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending default theme with custom colors (using OKLCH), typography, container queries, animations, and cybersecurity-themed design tokens including glow effects.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a Spanish-language cybersecurity presentation website for BlueFire targeting Mexican PYMEs and manufacturing plants, with features for hero section, services, market context, and target clients.
